source_fix: fastify/fastify@29bdcbb9 (2026-07-30, #6865): fix: honor quoted-string in Content-Type parameter values
supp_note: content-type.test.js is the post-fix file minus 'skips invalid quoted string parameters', whose expectation the fix changed in a way the issue does not imply (the pre-fix file asserts the old behavior), so it is neither an AC nor a regression.

acceptance.desc: ';' inside a quoted parameter value stays part of the value; later parameters still parse
acceptance.title: preserves a semicolon inside a quoted parameter value

acceptance.desc: key=value text inside a quoted value never becomes a parameter of its own
acceptance.title: does not leak a fake parameter out of a quoted value

acceptance.desc: quoted-pairs (backslash escapes) inside a quoted-string are unescaped, and an escaped quote does not end the value
acceptance.title: unescapes a quoted-pair inside a quoted-string

acceptance.desc: end to end: reply.send still appends charset=utf-8 when the only 'charset=' is inside a quoted value of another parameter
acceptance.title: reply.send should not treat charset= inside a quoted parameter value as an already-declared charset

decoys.desc: treats "..." as an opaque value but ignores backslash escapes
